statements.status_notes: RustSec RUSTSEC-2026-0249 is an unmaintained-crate advisory: the smartstring repository was archived in May 2026 and RustSec reports no patched release. smartstring 1.0.1 remains a transitive dependency in the apollo-mcp-server binary shipped by this image. Replacing it requires upstream crates to migrate to maintained alternatives such as compact_str or smol_str, which is a package-level dependency change rather than an image-only pin.
